The animal has cream/white fur on its face and chest, with darker fur visible on its body. It has a pink nose, dark eyes, and small rounded ears. The background is dark and out of focus, emphasizing the subject.

Both eyes are visible, appearing small, round, and dark/black, matching the description.
The ears are visible on the sides of the head; they are short and have a rounded tip, consistent with the taxonomy.

The legs are completely hidden by the human hands holding the animal. No limbs are visible for evaluation.

There is a rapid fall-off in sharpness from the face to the body. While this could be depth-of-field, the transition feels slightly unnatural, potentially masking structural details or fusion with the hands.
